Supermove Developer API New Lead Endpoint

items.docs: POST a moving lead as JSON to the account's unique endpoint URL. Supermove validates the payload against the documented lead schema and creates a new lead/project in the account. The header Content-Type: application/json is required. Most fields are optional; a project_type and at least basic client contact information are typically supplied.
